components.note: Composite goal. The five maximal clones are proved maximal and exactly five. Negative results are present: the bases theorem, plus the limitation theorems for the ternary operations g and h. The Sheffer stroke and NOR are covered: binary uniqueness, a characterization at every arity, and scope. Every item has a written proof. The original note ('one positive basis only in v1.0') is extended by further bases, not lost.

Defines Boolean operations of positive arity, projections, constant operations, composition, clones, generated clones and proper or maximal clones. States the arity and constant convention: the operation set C^+ takes each nullary member to kappa^1_b. Defines the two scopes of completeness.

Defines the five classes T0, T1, S, M and L, and proves them proper, pairwise incomparable clones. The criterion, for operation sets and for connective sets in both scopes, is proved in full at A8:396-493 (necessity, diagonals, constants, negation, then conjunction via ANF). Maximality, and that there are exactly five maximal clones, is proved at A8:496-522. All supporting lemmas are proved.

Negative bases, each with its excluded targets: {and,or}, {and,or,0,1}, {neg,iff}/{neg,xor}, {to}, {and,xor}, {neg,maj}. Positive bases {to,bot} and {and,xor,top}. Explicit NAND and NOR identities for negation, conjunction and both constants. Positive-arity and nullary-inclusive completeness are kept apart with proofs, covering single connectives and a connective plus constants.

evidence.label: thm:p02-w02-p02-008-alternating; the clone lattice, two-valued only

components.note: The clone-lattice figure is tied to thm maximal and to the bases theorem. Post's two-valued systems are named and matched to the five classes, with arguments that T1=C2, T0=C3 and M=A1, and with alternating=affine proved. The text states that nothing here concerns more than two truth values, so no different finite-valued presentation is substituted.

Active table of the five maximal clones and their exact membership tests, giving for each class its defining condition, exact truth-table test and evaluation count. The tests are proved exact, and maximality is proved.

evidence.label: figure tied to Post's diagram and the five boxed classes

components.note: The completeness criterion for a set of connectives is stated in both scopes, with a decision procedure that uses the table. The clone-diagram figure boxes the table's five classes, and its caption cites thm maximal. The text links the figure's nodes to the table's column of Post's names.

The table, criterion and figure are in files input by the active Part 2 body and annex drivers. They stand in for the equivalent in the inactive propositional-syntax-semantics.tex, and no unmatched old artifact is relied on.

duties.duty: Clarify positive-arity versus nullary-inclusive scope of single-connective completeness and supply the allocated expressive-limitation proofs/criterion. Current NAND/NOR identities do not give those full components.
duties.note: The scope is settled. A one-member connective set is never nullary-inclusive complete; a Sheffer connective is positive-arity complete. Exact criteria are given for {c,bot}, {c,top} and {c,bot,top}. The single-generator criterion is proved at every arity. The expressive-limitation proofs for g=1+maj and h=1+x+y+z, confined to S and to the intersection of S and L, are written out.
